items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And one night I told Maxie about this. And one night I told, I saw Maxie telling Marshal to turn it up a little. And Marshal came up Brown, you know.... A little louder and that's when I called Maxie a phony. He said, well I'm going to let you go tonight.

ctx.x: I said, you know one thing, you're bringing your blood pressure up. And sure enough he was. And I still say that's what caused this hypertension. That thing liked to worry Zuddy to death.
And Maxie Kaminsky, I told him about it. I said, man, you sitting and sitting right here and I'm right on the end, see, playing the drums. And Marshall Brown is over there.
